item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Russian drone strikes hit a Ukrainian railway station, killing 13, and attacks have cut power to thousands as the Kherson ceasefire ends. In Oleshky the localized truce ended, ending evacuations while aid vehicles continue to be attacked. Ukrainian forces struck an oil facility in Russia's Samara Oblast and a rocket fuel factory, while Russia reported a drone strike on a Ukrainian railway station. Cyber attacks disrupted emergency alert apps in both countries after the truce ended. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Settler violence continues in the West Bank, with a mother fearing her son’s killer after an attack on a town. Iran warned that renewed war with the US could outlast the previous conflict. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

The RSF continues to use drones against civilian infrastructure, while the UN is preparing talks with the RSF on a civilian transition. Sudan’s government has accused Ethiopia of supporting the attacks, and the conflict has expanded to include disputes over the power grid. 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

item.title: Ethiopia: the situation
item.description:

Sudan accuses Ethiopia of using Assosa Airport as a launch base for RSF drones and of supplying arms to the RSF. An RPG fired near a school in Moyale killed 60 Ethiopian Orthodox believers, prompting the Orthodox Church to demand action, and the conflict has displaced 1.7 million Ethiopians with an additional 173,000 affected by disasters, according to UNHCR. There were 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:

The United States has joined an East African nation in conducting airstrikes against a $100 million-earning group linked to the 9/11 attacks, and the UAE carried out its first drone strike against al-Shabaab in nearly a year. Somali pirates seized an Iranian fishing vessel, rescuing seven Pakistani crew members, and the UN political mission in Somalia ended after three decades. Uganda and Ethiopia are pulling their troops out after long deployments, and the African Union is withdrawing from four Lower Shabelle bases. The conflict caused 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
